title: Prominence on 30A Blue Whale Bungalow Prominence on 30A
meta_description: 30A Beach House - Blue Whale Bungalow - Dog Friendly, Beach, Pools - Golf Cart
description_expanded: AboutProminence 30A pet friendly beach house rental, Blue Whale Bungalow located in Watersound, Florida by Panhandle Getaways is a 3 bedroom plus bonus room, 3.5 bathroom beach house rental complete with all of the conveniences of home. Golf Cart, 4 Bikes, Pet Friendly Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card to share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES * Beach House on 30A - Golf Cart Included * Gulf Side Home * Large Living Area w/Queen Sleeper Sofa * Fully Equipped Kitchen w/Breakfast Bar * Dining Area * Main Bedroom w/King Bed & En Suite Bathroom * 2nd Bedroom w/Queen Bed * 3rd Bedroom w/Queen Bed * Bunk Area w/Bunk Bed (Twin/Twin) * Full Size Washer/Dryer * FREE Wi-Fi * Incredible Location * Sleeps 12 ***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR 2024 STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round * 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round * 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) About Prominence on 30A - Watersound, Florida Prominence on 30A is certain to attract families looking to experience the area with easy access to new and long time 30A haunts along the beautiful white beaches of The Panhandle. Prominence features incredible amenities, open green spaces & easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Guests will enjoy the community's beautiful town center and 2 resort style pools, 1 heated seasonally. The Big Chill, a family hot-spot for entertainment, features an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen which plays host to concerts, sporting events, movie nights on the green, family activities, restaurants and boutique shops. Guests will certainly enjoy Luke Bryan's place as it is a very popular place to gather. All of this within less than a 5 minute walk. Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of Seaside & Seagrove Beach on the west and Alys and Rosemary on the east. 20 minutes to Pier Park. COMMUNITY and THE BIG CHILL AMENITIES Walking distance to The Big Chill - Restaurants & Pubs, Boutique Shops & Nightly Entertainment Cigar and Gastro Pub - Luke Bryan's Place & Popular Hangout Onsite Ice Machine Kids Movie Nights and Sports Viewings at the Hub 2 Large Community Pool(s) with Beach Entry – perfect for the elderly and toddlers Barbecue Areas Proximity to the amenities at Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and Seaside 5 miles to nearest Grocery Store Please note: Pool heated seasonally is subject to change at any time by the HOA for the community. Panhandle Getaways is not responsible for any change in seasonal heating of the one pool in Prominence. No refunds for any change to pool heated seasonally. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVAL Panhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach.
